cancelSub.title: Cancel subscription
cancelSub.subtitle: Data will be deleted 15 days after cancellation.
cancelSub.warning:
IMPORTANT — Read this before continuing:

1. Download all your documents NOW, because once the subscription is cancelled you won't be able to access or view any document.

2. If you don't renew within 15 days, your account and ALL data (documents, companies, team) will be permanently deleted.

3. During the 15-day grace period you won't be able to upload, download or edit documents.
cancelSub.doneDesc: Your subscription has been cancelled. You have 15 days to download your documents before the account is deleted.
